assumptions: legacy branch preview coordinates are transformed to the current 4.8 m compact candidate by the frozen x-only map; y/z are retained and 3D arclength is recomputed
current dry-line native initialization supplies tank capacity, water, pressure, temperature, air thermo and wetted upstream-feed reference; Tank A is modeled as representative
compact line areas and transition losses remain an equivalent-line approximation; the network line volume is compared against current compact CAD and native zones
single full-bore water front per branch; no stratification, slugs, or trapped pockets
front Froude number is reported as a diagnostic and does not validate piston-front kinematics
front pressure is held at ambient only as a declared approximation and has an air-loss screen
unknown valve seat, Cd, opening history, bend loss, and actual branch geometry remain provisional
tank-to-line water entering the branch is stored until the front reaches the open mouth
moving_front_reference.front_model: single full-bore piston front per branch, vented ambient front pressure; no stratification, slugs, trapped pockets, or detailed compressible-air path losses

moving_front_reference.scope: current compact 1-tank / 2-branch equivalent line, downstream air, wetted feed through assumed valve plane

native48.source_scope: The native startup and continuation use the same frozen predictor-Sp binary hash and byte-identical mesh. The 1-D model is a separate equivalent-line/piston-front calculation with its own geometry and thermal assumptions. Model-vs-CFD differences cannot be assigned to numerical source or mesh alone.

partition.split_definition: line*InitialZone cells with centre x<2.25 m are tank-to-seat feed; x>=2.25 m are downstream line; explicit mouth slab zones and externalAirZone are separate.

native_mesh_and_partition.volume_split_note: The old line*InitialZone name covers the complete line outside each tank; this analysis splits its feed vs downstream line at the assumed seat x=2.25 m. Explicit mouth slabs and externalAirZone remain separate.

native_observables.fronts: Connected alpha.water threshold reachability on owner-neighbour native internal faces in tank+own train, seeded by qualifying tank cells; line cell centers are projected to the frozen compact branch centerline. Raw unconnected maxima are separately retained.
native_observables.gas_mass_proxy: For complete checkpoints, gas mass is estimated cellwise from p/(R_air*T.air), weighted by gas volume fraction and cell volume. This avoids using the solver's mixture rho as a gas-phase density. It is an EOS diagnostic, not a separate conservation ledger.
native_observables.inventory: Native alpha.water times cell V integrated over disjoint tank, feed, downstream line, mouth-slab and exterior masks; the assumed feed/line split is by cell-centre x=2.25 m.
native_observables.pressure: Tank-A native p probe at (1.25,-0.55,1.60) m for dense history, plus saved-field gas-volume-weighted p over tankAZone at each complete checkpoint; model pressure is absolute gas pressure.
native_observables.thermal_comparison: Native checkpoint gas temperature is T.air weighted by gas fraction and cell volume over tankAZone. The moving-front model uses its lumped polytropic gas-temperature history (n≈gamma); thermal-closure differences are reported separately and are not fitted away.
native_observables.valve_flux: Native signed sum(alphaPhi0.water) on fixed faceZones valveSeatA1/A2/B1/B2. A1/B1 are lower outlets by valve-band centroid y,z; A2/B2 are upper. Positive is the logged functionObject orientation from tank toward outlet.
